observations.reference_tool_conclusion: On this capture, TShark and FoxIO both expose the QUIC v1 ClientHello and report the same JA4; this capture does not demonstrate an L1 tool-coverage gap.
observations.reference_tools_share_dependency: FoxIO ja4 invokes system TShark; agreement is a useful cross-CLI check but not a fully independent packet-decoder comparison.
